name: cartify-mern
description: Cartify Backend is a Node.js and Express.js based REST API for an e-commerce application. It provides authentication, user management, product management, order processing, and payment integration.
author: shreya sah

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix Backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm install --prefix Backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
